title: 'The Interview': The Woman at the Center of the French Rape Trial That Shocked the World

sentences.en: From the New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《纽约时报》的《采访》节目。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia Navarro.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗。

sentences.en: It is one of the most heinous sexual abuse stories in history.
sentences.zh: 这是历史上最令人发指的性虐待案件之一。

sentences.en: Giselle Pellicot was drugged and raped repeatedly by the person she trusted most in the world, her husband Dominique Pellicot, who invited dozens of men into their bedroom
sentences.zh: 吉赛尔·佩利科被她世界上最信任的人——她的丈夫多米尼克·佩利科——反复下药并强奸，而她的丈夫还邀请了数十名男子进入他们的卧室，

sentences.en: to also rape her while she was heavily sedated.
sentences.zh: 趁她处于深度镇静状态时也对她实施了强奸。

sentences.en: Giselle discovered what had happened to her in 2020 after Dominique Pellicot was caught filming up women's skirts at a local supermarket.
sentences.zh: 2020年，多米尼克·佩利科因在当地一家超市偷拍女性裙底被抓，吉赛尔这才发现了发生在她身上的事。

sentences.en: After police arrested him, they found thousands of videos and images of his wife being violently assaulted by at least 70 men.
sentences.zh: 警方逮捕他后，发现了数千段视频和照片，记录了他的妻子被至少70名男子暴力侵犯的过程。

sentences.en: Many were stored in a digital folder titled Abuse.
sentences.zh: 其中许多文件被存放在一个名为“虐待”的数字文件夹中。

sentences.en: Four years later, France's largest ever mass rape trial began.
sentences.zh: 四年后，法国历史上规模最大的集体强奸案审判开始了。

sentences.en: Even then, we might have never known Giselle Pellicot's name.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，我们本可能永远不会知道吉赛尔·佩利科的名字。

sentences.en: But in a decision that shocked the world, she waived her right to anonymity, and the trial became public.
sentences.zh: 但她做出了一个震惊世界的决定：放弃匿名权，公开审判。

sentences.en: That made her a global icon and inspired a movement of women who marched in demonstrations all over France to demand change to the country's consent laws.
sentences.zh: 这使她成为了全球偶像，并激励了一场女性运动，她们在法国各地举行示威游行，要求改变国家的同意法。

sentences.en: Still, despite her fame,
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管她已广为人知，

sentences.en: Giselle remained in many ways an enigma.
sentences.zh: 吉赛尔在许多方面仍然是一个谜。

sentences.en: Outside of the trial, she'd never sat down to tell her story until now.
sentences.zh: 在审判之外，直到现在，她从未坐下来讲述过自己的故事。

sentences.en: She's written a new memoir called
sentences.zh: 她写了一本新回忆录，书名为

sentences.en: A Hymn to Life, Shame Has to Change Sides, and over an extended interview last month in Paris, her first with an American media outlet.
sentences.zh: 《生命的赞歌，羞耻必须易位》。上个月在巴黎，她接受了一次长时间的采访，这也是她首次接受美国媒体的采访。

sentences.en: Giselle spoke with me about the early years of her marriage, the toll the abuse and trial took on her and her family, and how, despite everything she's been through,
sentences.zh: 吉赛尔与我谈到了她婚姻的早期岁月，谈到了虐待和审判给她及家人带来的创伤，以及尽管经历了这一切，

sentences.en: she's found love and a sense of peace again.
sentences.zh: 她是如何重新找到爱与内心的平静的。

sentences.en: What you'll hear is a voiceover in English of Giselle's original French answers.
sentences.zh: 你接下来听到的是吉赛尔法语原话的英语配音。

sentences.en: Here's my interview with the extraordinary Giselle Pellicot.
sentences.zh: 以下是我对非凡的吉赛尔·佩利科的采访。

sentences.en: Madame, I am so happy to have you here today.
sentences.zh: 夫人，今天能见到您，我感到非常高兴。

sentences.en: Your book is gripping.

sentences.en: It is heartbreaking.

sentences.en: It is beautifully written.

sentences.en: And this is the first time that people will be able to have heard from you personally, your own words, your own story.
sentences.zh: 这是人们第一次能够亲自听到您的讲述，听到您自己的话语，您自己的故事。

sentences.en: How are you feeling sitting down and discussing this really in a public way for the first time?
sentences.zh: 第一次以这种公开的方式坐下来讨论这些事情，您感觉如何？

sentences.en: First, I want to say that when I wrote this book, I wanted it to be useful.
sentences.zh: 首先，我想说，当我写这本书时，我希望它是有用的。

sentences.en: And it also allowed me to look inward at myself, to take stock of my life, and to try to rebuild myself from the ruins.
sentences.zh: 它也让我能够审视内心，盘点我的人生，并尝试从废墟中重建自我。

sentences.en: When you hear the facts of the trial on September 2, 2020, you see this woman and wonder how is she still standing after all she has been through.
sentences.zh: 当你听到2020年9月2日审判中的事实时，你会看到这个女人，并想知道在经历了这一切之后，她是如何坚持下来的。

sentences.en: You had retired to the southeast of France and a town called Mazin.
sentences.zh: 那时您已经退休，搬到了法国东南部一个叫马赞的小镇。

sentences.en: What kind of person were you then?

sentences.en: I mean, how would you have described yourself?
sentences.zh: 我是说，您会如何描述当时的自己？

sentences.zh: 那时的我刚过60岁，刚刚退休。

sentences.en: I had always worked, raised my children, and had a very active life.
sentences.zh: 我一直都在工作，抚养孩子，生活非常充实。

sentences.en: And I thought I would have a happy retirement with Monsieur Pellicot.
sentences.zh: 我以为我会和佩利科先生一起度过幸福的退休生活。

sentences.zh: 我们一直称它为“幸福之家”。

sentences.zh: 我们离普罗旺斯莱博的旺图山不远。

sentences.zh: 我过着充实而幸福的生活。

sentences.zh: 当然，像所有夫妻一样，我们也经历过困难时期。
